reviews.title: LIGHTWEIGHT AND HYDRATING, GOOD SUNPROTECTION TOO.
reviews.text: just received the product yesterday, writing my opinion after just first application. this is like a moisturizer, slightly runny creme like texture, easily gets absorbed in the skin, without leaving any oily residue and the best part no white cast what so ever. it blends in to the skin with minimal effort, almost immediately after application, settles in to non-greasy finish. now coming to the sunscreen filters, it has Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane (Avobenzone - the only globally available chemical sunscreen that gives proper UVA protection. It is not photostable so has to be combined with ingredients that help to stabilize it.), Terephthalylidene Dicamphor Sulfonic Acid (A L'Oréal-group exclusive sunscreen agent commonly called Mexoryl SX. As opposed to most sunscreen agents, it is water soluble and protects in the UVA range with a peak absorbance at 345 nm.), Phenylbenzimidazole Sulfonic Acid (A chemical sunscreen agent that gives a strong protection in the UVB (280-320nm) range with a peak protection at 306 nm.), Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate (Octinoxate - an old-school chemical sunscreen that absorbs UVB radiation (wavelengths: 280-320 nm). Not photostable and does not protect against UVA.), Ethylhexyl Salicylate (A colorless to light yellowish oily liquid that works as a UVB (280-320nm) sunscreen filter with a peak absorbance at 306 nm. It's not a strong filter in itself, it's always used in combination with other sunscreen agents.), Methylene Bis-Benzotriazolyl Tetramethylbutylphenol (Tinosorb M - a new generation, "hybrid" (between physical and chemical agents) sunscreen that gives broad-spectrum coverage and is highly photostable.). these combined modern and old school filters makes it a good and photo stable sunscreen. along with that it contains antioxidants like Niacinamide, Capsicum Annuum Fruit Extract, Tocopheryl Acetate to safeguard the skin from external pollutants, humectants like Glycerin and Sodium Hyaluronate for hydration, skin soothing agents like Blueberry Extract and Allantoin to calm down skin irritation. it also contains tapioca starch, which is known for absorbing oil, providing a matte finish, and creating a silky texture, so it is suitable for people with oily skin. it does not contain any fragrance, so less likely to irritate sensitive skin.
